meta.name: NexaSST Active Prevention
meta.description: Public landing identity derived from the approved mobile direction and the existing calm operational web system. It frames NexaSST as an active prevention instrument rather than a generic SST software category.

color.palette_type: analogous navy and emerald with restrained amber and red semantics

primary.role: brand structure, trust, navigation and high emphasis surfaces

secondary.role: primary actions, positive state and active prevention

accent.role: measured highlight for CTA emphasis, progress and selective visual focus

neutral.usage: White and measured warm white carry the page. Slate values organize borders and supporting copy. Deep navy and the measured near black provide foreground contrast.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark navy on light fields dominates. White on navy is reserved for decisive chapters. Emerald signals action and state rather than decoration.

typography.font_style_notes: One humanist geometric family, sentence case, no italics and no black weight. Headlines use meaningful line breaks and balanced wrapping.

spacing.content_density: spacious marketing shell with compact product evidence
spacing.section_rhythm: Large 80px to 96px pauses between argument chapters, with one calm short interlude before pricing and the final CTA.

layout.grid_system: 12 column responsive grid with stable outer rails
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed, anchored by a strict grid with controlled editorial offsets

shape.border_usage: Subtle one pixel borders around true groups and controls; no decorative single side borders.
shape.divider_style: One pixel cool slate dividers on light surfaces and translucent white dividers on navy.

elevation.depth_cues: Layer overlap, measured shadow, tonal surface shifts and the dimensional safety assets.

iconography.style: Phosphor line icons for interface plus soft studio 3D safety objects for campaign moments

motion.entrance_pattern: Occasional fade and 8px rise for narrative content; word by word color activation in the tagline reveal.
motion.exit_pattern: Faster opacity and transform retreat without scale below 0.95.
motion.philosophy: Functional and explanatory. One authored brand moment, crisp interaction feedback, no repeated spectacle and a reduced motion path.

components.button_style: Emerald primary button, 12px radius, 8px vertical and 12px horizontal padding, visible focus ring and 0.97 active scale.
components.input_style: White surface, full one pixel slate border, 12px radius, 48px minimum height and explicit inline validation.
components.card_style: Cards only for grouped choices, proof or pricing; otherwise use open grid composition, dividers and whitespace.
components.navigation_pattern: Compact floating light navigation on desktop and a full screen accessible mobile overlay anchored to the trigger.
components.modal_style: Centered, restrained 16px radius, dimmed navy backdrop and no dramatic scale animation.
components.list_style: Editorial rows with aligned evidence, deadlines or outcomes instead of repeated isolated cards.
components.component_notes: Every interactive element includes hover, active, focus, loading, disabled and error treatment. Use real product screenshots and real prices only.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A precision prevention instrument that detects weak signals before they become incidents, penalties or operational loss.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary Brazilian B2B with editorial information design and native mobile utility.
aesthetic.genre: trust driven B2B SaaS with industrial campaign art direction

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle 3D safety accents with one high impact hero composition
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous, used to separate recognition, explanation, proof and decision
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Deep navy chapters anchor a mostly light page; emerald concentrates on action and prevention state.
visual_language.focal_strategy: Progressive reveal from risk recognition to operational proof to commercial action.
visual_language.texture_usage: Matte surfaces and soft object shadows; no ambient mesh gradients or decorative noise fields.

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast, spatial isolation and evidence placed beside the claim it supports
composition.flow_direction: top left diagnostic hook into a vertical cause and response narrative
composition.grouping_strategy: open chapters, continuous evidence rows and only a few meaningful containers
composition.negative_space_role: creates confidence and gives financial and legal claims room to be read carefully

imagery.photo_treatment: If used, authentic Brazilian field environments with a single cool navy grade and clear safe areas for text.
imagery.illustration_style: Existing soft 3D safety objects with transparent background, studio light and consistent matte materials.
imagery.graphic_elements: The dimensional shield, inspection timeline, evidence trail, QR and product screen crops.
imagery.pattern_usage: No repeating decorative pattern; a single route or trace line may connect prevention stages.
imagery.image_shape: Clean cutouts, wide environmental crops and device or browser frames with 16px radius.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate and quiet with press depth and precise focus
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Small contrast shift or 2px lift on fine pointers only
interaction_feel.transition_personality: crisp ease out for UI and measured cinematic pacing only for explanatory sections
interaction_feel.loading_style: Skeletons shaped like the content or a direct inline status

brand_voice_in_ui.formality: professional Brazilian Portuguese without legalistic distance
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct invitation tied to a concrete diagnostic or demonstration
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain what is missing, why it matters and the next real action.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Direct, specific and recovery oriented without blame.

overview.fallback_strategy: Disable spatial movement and preserve opacity and color feedback under reduced motion.

background_effects.description: Flat brand surfaces are used instead of animated or gradient backgrounds.

particle_systems.description: Particles would weaken the operational and prevention led positioning.

3d_elements.description: Pre rendered dimensional logo and safety objects form an authored hero and occasional section anchors.
3d_elements.technology: optimized transparent WebP or PNG assets

params.materials: matte polymer, rubber and brushed metal
params.interaction_model: subtle pointer parallax on fine pointers only

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: fade up and word color reveal
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: tagline words only; other entrances are not scrubbed

scroll_morphing.description: No geometry morphing; it would compete with the argument.

text_effects.description: The mandatory benefit statement activates word by word from muted navy to full navy as it crosses a reading line.

cursor_effects.description: Native cursor behavior supports trust and usability.

image_effects.description: Hero safety objects and one product frame can move by a few pixels to communicate depth without spectacle.
image_effects.technology: CSS transforms with pointer media query

canvas_drawings.description: The page does not need canvas rendering.

svg_animations.description: The official logo remains an image asset and is not reconstructed as an animated SVG.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The authored depth comes from real pre rendered brand assets, not a realtime 3D scene. Use one signature hero arrangement and keep subsequent motion quieter. The reduced motion version removes parallax and transforms while retaining readable state changes.
